typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage3_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		High as integer,
		HighSelection2 as integer,
		Low as integer,
		SOR as string,
		LowSelection2 as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblY14TradeTestingStage2
fromtblY14TradeTestingStage2 sink(input(
		High as integer,
		HighSelection2 as integer,
		Low as integer,
		SOR as string,
		LowSelection2 as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		High,
		HighSelection2,
		Low,
		SOR,
		LowSelection2),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage3_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage3
